name: TasmoBackup-py
description: Backup all your Tasmota and WLED devices from one web UI - a modern Python rewrite of TasmoBackup. Scheduled and on-demand backups (Tasmota .dmp, WLED config + presets), one-click restore, device discovery via IP scan or MQTT, online status with ntfy/Gotify/webhook alerts, Tasmota time-zone check, and an optional firmware auto-update that is opt-in per device and always takes a fresh backup first. Login-protected, device passwords encrypted at rest, no tracking. German and English UI.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Database, secret key and all device backups.

variables.name: Admin user
variables.description: Web UI login name. Only used on the very first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Initial web UI password. Only used on the very first start - change it later in Settings.

variables.name: Default Tasmota user
variables.description: Web login used for devices without their own credentials.

variables.name: Default Tasmota password
variables.description: Web password used for devices without their own credentials. Leave empty if your devices have none.

variables.name: Secret key
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty to generate one automatically (stored in appdata). If set, never change it - stored device passwords could no longer be decrypted.

variables.name: Login enabled
variables.description: Set to false only if an external auth proxy protects the web UI.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users).
